name: Black New World Order
source:
Follow the life of a family living under the dystopian rule of the Black New World Order. 24/7 monitoring, forced drug injections, and black domination all await to tweak and tantalize the senses. Will this family be able to survive and thrive under the new world order? Only time will tell.

[From F95Zone]
translation:
跟随一个家庭，体验他们在“黑人新世界秩序”的反乌托邦统治下的生活。全天候监控、强制药物注射，以及黑人的支配，都将刺激、撩拨你的感官。这个家庭能否在新世界秩序下生存，甚至过得更好？唯有时间能够给出答案。

[摘自F95Zone]
